claude.performance_metric: NCI share of venture net income rose $5,514k (2015) → $6,541k (2016) → $7,192k (2017); no impairment/write-down/divestiture; venture retained and consolidated
claude.rationale: P4 = 0: no product/process incoherence is documented; the venture retained its China retail (92 locations) and e-commerce footprint and grew profitability across the window with no operational breakdown disclosed. P5 = 0: rather than a process/organization fracture, the operating-substrate transition wound down smoothly — TSA fees fell from $5,974k (2015) to $1,006k (2017) as the Company internalized back-office functions, personnel, and IT, completing the systems migration to its platform in Q2 2017. No dominance-archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility is documented; the venture remained a consolidated 60%-owned entity with no impairment or dissolution.

gemini.performance_metric: non-controlling-interest share of venture net income rising $5,514,000 (2015) to $7,192,000 (2017)
gemini.rationale: The slice documents a successful transition of back-office functions and IT systems to the Company's platform by Q2 2017, with TSA fees declining significantly. There is no evidence of product/process incoherence (p4_pathway) or process/organization fracture (p5_pathway). The joint venture remained operational and profitable, with no impairments or divestitures reported.
